boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain University of Massachusetts-Lowell
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe Lowell food stops with publicly posted late hours; confirm hours before leaving, especially on holidays.

cards.title: Food Shines
cards.subtitle: 277 Pawtucket St, Lowell
cards.notes: Use the posted hours to plan a late pickup or dine-in meal on Pawtucket Street; the restaurant lists vegan options alongside its regular menu.
cards.short_summary: Nepalese, Indian, American and Asian dishes served into the early morning.
cards.evidence_claim: Food Shines lists its Lowell address at 277 Pawtucket St and hours through 1:45 a.m. Monday through Friday, 1 a.m. Saturday, and 1:45 a.m. Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Posted business hours: Mon 11:30 a.m.–1:45 a.m.; Tue 11:30 a.m.–1:46 a.m.; Wed–Fri 11:30 a.m.–1:45 a.m.; Sat until 1 a.m.; Sun until 1:45 a.m.

cards.title: Wah Sang Restaurant
cards.subtitle: 457 Chelmsford St, Lowell
cards.notes: Check the day’s closing time, then use the restaurant’s online ordering option for a late takeout plan on Chelmsford Street.
cards.short_summary: A Chinese restaurant with late nightly hours listed on its own ordering site.
cards.evidence_claim: Wah Sang Restaurant lists 457 Chelmsford St, Lowell, with hours until 1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 2 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours: Sun–Thu 10 a.m.–1 a.m.; Fri–Sat 10 a.m.–2 a.m. Check before travel.

cards.title: Cathay Wok
cards.subtitle: 450 Bridge St, Lowell
cards.notes: Plan for Friday or Saturday if you need the latest listed window, and use the restaurant’s menu-and-order page to verify service before heading out.
cards.short_summary: Bridge Street Chinese takeout with 1 a.m. Friday and Saturday closing.
cards.evidence_claim: Cathay Wok lists its address at 450 Bridge St, Lowell, and Friday and Saturday opening hours from noon until 1 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours: Friday and Saturday noon–1 a.m.; Wednesday and Thursday until 11 p.m.; other days vary.

cards.title: Domino's Pizza on Lakeview Avenue
cards.subtitle: 90 Lakeview Ave, Lowell
cards.notes: Use the store’s official ordering page to check the live closing time and place a pickup or delivery order before the late cutoff.
cards.short_summary: A Lakeview Avenue pizza store whose official page shows late closing availability.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino's official Lowell page identifies the store at 90 Lakeview Ave and shows it open until 2 a.m. when fetched.
cards.access_notes: Official store page showed “Today Until 2:00 AM” when fetched. Live store hours can change, so recheck before ordering.

cards.title: Santoro's Sub Shop
cards.subtitle: 194 Gorham St, Lowell
cards.notes: Use the shop’s directions page to confirm the appropriate nightly window, then choose pickup or delivery rather than assuming a kitchen cutoff.
cards.short_summary: A Gorham Street sub and pizza shop with midnight-to-2 a.m. posted hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Santoro's lists 194 Gorham St, Lowell, with hours until midnight Sunday–Wednesday and until 1 a.m. Thursday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Santoro's Sub Shop — Direction and Hours
cards.access_notes: Posted hours: Sun–Wed 10 a.m.–midnight; Thu–Sat 10 a.m.–1 a.m. Verify holiday or delivery availability directly.

cards.title: Cafeto
cards.subtitle: 1018 Gorham St, Lowell
cards.notes: For a Friday or Saturday late stop, check Cafeto’s official location page and use its online-order link before making the trip.
cards.short_summary: A Gorham Street café listing 2 a.m. Friday and Saturday business hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Cafeto lists its Lowell location at 1018 Gorham St and business hours until 2 a.m. on Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Posted business hours: 7 a.m.–9 p.m. Sunday–Thursday; 7 a.m.–2 a.m. Friday and Saturday.

cards.title: Time Out Café and Eatery
cards.subtitle: 72 Merrimack St, Lowell
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s posted Wednesday-through-Saturday schedule to time a late meal, and confirm operations before starting downtown.
cards.short_summary: A Merrimack Street café with midnight and 2 a.m. late-week hours posted.
cards.evidence_claim: Time Out Café and Eatery lists 72 Merrimack St, Lowell, with hours until midnight Wednesday–Thursday and 2 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours: Wed–Thu 9 a.m.–midnight; Fri 9 a.m.–2 a.m.; Sat 11 a.m.–2 a.m. Closed Sunday; verify before travel.

cards.title: Mandarin Asian Bistro
cards.subtitle: 24 Market St, Lowell
cards.notes: Check the official location-and-hours page for Friday or Saturday pickup and delivery windows before setting out for Market Street.
cards.short_summary: A Market Street Asian bistro with 1 a.m. Friday and Saturday pickup hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Mandarin Asian Bistro lists its Lowell location at 24 Market St and pickup hours until 1 a.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Mandarin Asian Bistro — Location and Hours
cards.access_notes: Posted pickup hours: Friday 11:30 a.m.–1 a.m.; Saturday 1 p.m.–1 a.m. Delivery is listed until 12:30 a.m. on those days.

cards.title: Mira Ve
cards.subtitle: 105 Mammoth Rd, Lowell
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s official site to check the Friday or Saturday closing time and kitchen timing before planning a late food stop.
cards.short_summary: A Mammoth Road Colombian street-food restaurant with midnight weekend hours listed.
cards.evidence_claim: Mira Ve lists 105 Mammoth Rd, Lowell, and posted Friday and Saturday hours until midnight; it notes that the kitchen closes 30 minutes earlier.
cards.access_notes: Posted Friday and Saturday hours end at midnight; the official site says the kitchen closes 30 minutes before closing.

cards.title: Lowell Asian Bakery and Restaurant
cards.subtitle: 369 Broadway St, Lowell
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s ordering page to verify the day’s closing time, then plan a late pickup from its food and bakery selection.
cards.short_summary: A Broadway Street restaurant and bakery with midnight weeknight and 1 a.m. weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Lowell Asian Bakery and Restaurant lists 369 Broadway St, Lowell, with hours until midnight Sunday–Thursday and 1 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Lowell Asian Bakery and Restaurant — Online Ordering
cards.access_notes: Posted hours: Sun–Thu 10 a.m.–midnight; Fri–Sat 10 a.m.–1 a.m. Check online ordering availability before departure.
